text:
Aisha (Finance): heads-up — our Feb invoice shows ~1.2M embedding units billed for acct ACME_CORP but the usage dashboard only shows ~780k. does anyone know if we ran a backfill or double-counted?
Marco (Billing): hmm, I see the invoice line. Looks like an embed units charge + a token charge for the same calls? need to check the raw events.
Lina (Data Eng): pinging from data eng — we did a usage pipeline reprocess on 2026-02-28 to ingest delayed logs, but it should have dedup steps. I'll query the raw events.
Ben (Platform): @Lina can you share the query and a sample event id? also check if the metering service emitted both `embedding` and `generation` events for the same request id.
Lina (Data Eng): running quick check: ```sql
-- find potential duplicate request_ids for ACME_CORP embeddings
select request_id, count(*) as cnt, array_agg(distinct event_type) as types
from usage_raw
where org_id = 'acme_corp' and ts >= '2026-02-01' and ts < '2026-03-01'
group by request_id
having count(*) > 1
order by cnt desc
limit 10;
```
Lina (Data Eng): sample output: `req_8a3f..` cnt=2 types=["embedding","embedding"] ; `req_b12c..` cnt=2 types=["embedding","generation"]
Aisha (Finance): interesting — that second one looks like the same client call was tagged twice with different event types. could explain double billing if both map to billable units.
metering-bot: automated notice — background backfill job `usage-replay-2026-02-28` completed at 2026-03-01T03:12:18Z. 3,842,111 events processed.
Marco (Billing): ok meter-bot confirms backfill. @Lina do we know whether the replay re-emitted events that were already in the billing ledger without dedup keys?
Lina (Data Eng): the replay code should set `replay_id` and dedupe on `(request_id, replay_id)` but we discovered a bug where embeddings had null `request_id` for older clients; replay then assigned new surrogate ids. so duplicates could happen.
Ben (Platform): that matches. there was an incident last year where older SDKs didn't tag `request_id`. the metering writer used `message_id` when present, otherwise generated uuid. replay used a new uuid if old field missing.
Aisha (Finance): can we quantify the overcharge? Marco, what's the delta between invoice units and dashboard units?
Marco (Billing): invoice shows 1,217,340 embed units; dashboard aggregates show 781,912 embed units for Feb. delta = 435,428 embed units (approx $2,173 at list). we should run a recount and prepare a credit if duplicates are confirmed.
Lina (Data Eng): I'll run a deduped recount: ```sql
-- dedupe by stable keys when available
select sum(billable_units) from (
  select coalesce(request_id, message_id) as dedupe_key, max(billable_units) as billable_units
  from usage_processed
  where org_id='acme_corp' and month='2026-02'
  group by dedupe_key
) t;
```
Lina (Data Eng): early run returns ~782k units, matches dashboard. full recount in 10m.
Marco (Billing): thanks. if recount confirms ~782k we should issue a pro-rated credit for ~435k units and adjust the ledger. need approval from finance lead to post credit.
Aisha (Finance): approve provisional credit up to $2,500 pending final recount and legal review. please prepare journal entry and customer note.
Ben (Platform): also action item for eng: add stronger dedupe keys to metering events and run a 30-day retrospective check to find other orgs affected.
Lina (Data Eng): noted. filing infra ticket TF-2249 to update replay to preserve original message_id when request_id missing, and add a dedupe audit job.
metering-bot: replay audit summary — potential duplicates detected for 12 orgs, total ~1.1M suspect embed units. (this is a detection; not yet validated)
Marco (Billing): rough scope looks bigger. for ACME_CORP we'll do a targeted recount and then decide whether to run mass reconciliations.
Aisha (Finance): please tag me when the recount is done. also loop in CS for the customer communication draft.
Lina (Data Eng): recount finished: confirmed 781,908 deduped embed units. delta 435,432.
Marco (Billing): updated ledger: created credit memo CM-2026-0421 for $2,176.16 pending legal signoff. posting scheduled for next billing cycle.
Aisha (Finance): thanks team. follow-ups: (1) Ben/Lina ensure replay fixes, (2) Marco coordinate legal & CS, (3) I'll approve final credit once legal ok's wording.
Ben (Platform): assigning TF-2249 to me. will prioritize.
Marco (Billing): closing loop — will send customer note draft to CS + Aisha by EOD. :email: 
Aisha (Finance): great. leaving this thread open until customer confirmed. :thumbsup:
